title: aster salsuginosus var. scaposus
intro: Aster salsuginosus var. scaposus, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a plant species within the daisy family, known for its distinctive white flowers and fern-like foliage. Western Yarrow has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause, menstrual cramps, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Western Yarrow include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in soothing skin irritations, calming nervous system imbalances, and regulating menstrual cycles. The bioactive constituents of Western Yarrow include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are still being studied for their potential health benefits.
